note: Transitions are scaffolded from data/images.json by `make matrix-scaffold`. no_image verdicts are set from the registry. Every other verdict comes only from verification runs by the upgrader itself (verify/harness.py), on an empty and a seeded database, and names both evidence records. Preflight results from a user's cluster are never written here.

entries.reason: PostgreSQL 11 -> 12 -> 13 with pg_upgrade under Patroni: 11 -> 12 at 2.1.1 in pg12.6-ts2.1.1-p2; 12 -> 13 at 2.11.2 in pg13.12-ts2.11.2-all. The fewest pg_upgrade runs the measured images allow: none carries pg11 with anything past 12. pg_upgrade writes an update_extensions.sql (ALTER EXTENSION timescaledb UPDATE, to the image's default release); it is not run, since it would skip the planned stops. Verified copying and with --link (relation files hard-linked to the old directory), ending on PostgreSQL 13.22; with --link the old data directory is unusable once the new cluster starts. The seeded checks pass and the data is intact (840 materialized rows, 0 differing buckets, writes and refresh work), as in the same-PG pg13 2.1 -> 2.15 rows. A continuous aggregate created before 2.7 (non-finalized) can no longer be altered from 2.14.0 (`Continuous Aggregates with partials is not supported anymore`), so the checks read it below its watermark. Migrate such aggregates with cagg_migrate() below 2.25, which removes both the old format and cagg_migrate().
